# ==============================================================================
# LAMMPS Input Script | Al FCC Bulk MD with EAM
# Generated by input-build
# ==============================================================================

# ==============================================================================
# 1. SIMULATION ENVIRONMENT
# ==============================================================================
units           metal               # eV, Å, ps, K, bar
atom_style      atomic              # For EAM (no bond info)
boundary        p p p               # 3D periodic
newton          on

# ==============================================================================
# 2. SYSTEM SETUP
# ==============================================================================
read_data       system.data         # 4 Al atoms, FCC bulk

# ==============================================================================
# 3. FORCE FIELD (EAM)
# ==============================================================================
pair_style      eam                 # Al_u3.eam = funcfl 单元素格式 -> pair_style eam
pair_coeff      * * Al_u3.eam       # funcfl 仅 3 参数（无元素符号）；带元素符号的
                                    # 4 参数形式属 setfl（*.eam.alloy）的 eam/alloy

# ==============================================================================
# 4. ENERGY MINIMIZATION
# ==============================================================================
min_style       cg
minimize        1.0e-4 1.0e-6 1000 10000

# ==============================================================================
# 5. TEMPERATURE INITIALIZATION
# ==============================================================================
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

# ==============================================================================
# 6. EQUILIBRATION (NVT)
# ==============================================================================
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

timestep        0.0005              # 0.5 fs

fix             equil all nvt temp 300.0 300.0 0.05

thermo          100
thermo_style    custom step temp press pe ke etotal vol density cpu

run             20000               # 10 ps equilibration
unfix           equil

# ==============================================================================
# 7. PRODUCTION (NVT)
# ==============================================================================
fix             prod all nvt temp 300.0 300.0 0.05

dump            1 all custom 100 traj.lammpstrj id type x y z
dump_modify     1 sort id

restart         10000 restart1.restart restart2.restart

run             200000              # 100 ps production

# ==============================================================================
# END OF INPUT
# ==============================================================================
